title: ByteFleet
description: A premium taxi and chauffeur website for a Belgian transport company. Visitors can plan a ride with pickup, destination, date and passenger details, browse the services and fleet, and the site is available in English, French and Dutch.

title: LexiPlay
description: A learning web app for children with dyslexia. New words are practised in five short games, with an OpenDyslexic font option and a parent dashboard that tracks progress.

title: Donation app
description: A donation page for De Warmste Week. Payments run through Mollie, each donation is stored and streamed to a live screen, and donors can get a confirmation by email.

title: Doodley
description: A real-time drawing and guessing game. One player draws while the others guess in a live chat; the faster the guess, the more it scores. Players join a room with a five-character code or a QR scan.

title: EnterIn
description: A walkable cinema built in Unreal Engine 5. Each door opens onto a short film-inspired experience, including a horror sequence based on Insidious. Built solo in a month, and awarded a prize by Artevelde University.

title: JobFalcon
description: A personal Telegram bot that searches UK software-engineering vacancies, checks each listing's own wording for visa sponsorship, and verifies employers against the official register of licensed sponsors. It runs scheduled searches and only alerts on new listings.
